notes.title: GOD mode fixed
notes.content: [p]GOD god mode synchronization issues fixed. Fixed the issue of not working with the normal version.[/p]

notes.title: Zombies released with zombie mode
notes.content: [p]Zombies have been released with zombie mode. [/p][p]Now the sections progress gradually. And there are more sections. [/p][p]Section levels have been left open for future planning. [/p][p]Keyboard arm support has been improved. Now the controls are more stable. [/p][p]Skill classes have been added for heroes. notes.title: The zombie invasion is starting very soon
notes.content: The zombie invasion is starting very soon. Details are coming soon, follow us and don't miss the discount days. The game is currently discounted and is being prepared for many innovations.
